Recently, Centrus Energy Corp. of the United States and advanced nuclear development company Oklo Inc. officially announced the signing of a definitive multi-year commercial fuel supply purchase agreement. Under the agreement, Centrus Energy will produce high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) at its American Centrifuge Plant in Pike County, Ohio, to provide long-term fuel assurance for up to five Aurora Powerhouse microreactors that Oklo plans to deploy.
